sourceChecks.text: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.

wikipediaArticleRead.title: Jether
wikipediaArticleRead.noteJa: 記事はアマサの父を取り上げ、2サムエル記ではイテラ、別の聖書記述ではエテルと呼ばれると記します。
wikipediaArticleRead.verifiedHeadingOrText: Article line 107 identifies the father of Amasa and explicitly says he is called Ithra in 2 Samuel 17:25. Amasa article lines 123–124 confirms the same association.

notesJa: 固定WEB節本文と前後文脈を確認。用例ID、表記、初出時点を記録。
